sentences.text: You want to make good a track of zero nine zero true at a boat speed of ten knots, and the current sets one eight zero at two knots, pushing you south.
From the start, draw two miles toward one eight zero.
From that point, swing ten miles until you hit the track line.
The line you just swung runs about zero seven eight true, so you steer zero seven eight, crabbing about twelve degrees into the current.
Your speed along the track, the speed made good, is about nine point eight knots.
